title: Agreement on a set of states
statement: Let $M$ and $N$ be deterministic Turing machines with the same number of work tapes, alphabet, and state set, and let $Q$ be a set of states. They agree on $Q$ when, for every state in $Q$, every possibly blank input symbol, and every tuple of possibly blank work-tape symbols, their transition actions are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Two machines with the same number of work tapes, alphabet, and state set
